Bride Wars is an upcoming American romantic comedy series based on the 2009 romantic comedy film of the same name. The series will star and be executive produced by Emma Roberts, and will premiere on Peacock.
Cast
* Emma Roberts
Development
On February 25, 2026, it was announced that a romantic comedy television series based on a loose reimagining of the 2009 romantic comedy film Bride Wars, was in development at Peacock. It was also announced that Emma Roberts will star and executive produce the series, alongside Sascha Rothchild who will write and also executive produce the series.
The series will be executive produced by Emma Roberts, Karah Preiss, Matt Matruski, Arnon Milchan, Yariv Milchan, Natalie Lehmann, Sascha Rothchild, Alexandra Milchan, and Martin Salgo. Production companies involved with the series are New Regency, Roberts and Preiss' Belletrist Productions, Milchan's Crescent Line Productions, 20th Television, and Universal Content Productions.
